validator.manual: PhilHealth Identification Number — exactly 12 digits, no separators or spaces. Required if first_name, last_name, and patient_dob are not supplied.

Beneficiary birth date, format MM/DD/YYYY. Required if patient_pin is not supplied (name-based lookup, with first_name and last_name).

empanelment.manual: Required on the first request with patient_verification_mode = VALID_ID for the same patient, facility and date; may be sent as an empty string on later requests that day. Base-64 encoded JPEG of the ID, at most 2 MB before encoding.
